build_audio_filter_desc: build an FFmpeg audio filter expression to resample, trim, and pad audio frames
build_video_filter_desc: build an FFmpeg video filter expression to scale, crop, and pad video frames
build_filter_desc_from_packets: build an FFmpeg filter expression by dispatching on audio, video, or image packet type
build_abuffer_desc: build an abuffer filter description from an audio codec for use in a FilterGraph
build_buffer_desc: build a buffer filter description from a video or image codec for use in a FilterGraph
